existing.name: Jehan-e-Khusrau Palace
existing.issue: fabricated — 'Jehan-e-Khusrau Palace' does not exist as a Bhopal hotel. The sources cited all point to Jehan Numa Palace Hotel (the real property). 'Jehan-e-Khusrau' is an unrelated annual Sufi music festival in Delhi/Hyderabad. Likely a name-mangling of the real property.

replacement.name: Jehan Numa Palace Hotel
replacement.tagline: 1890s Scindia-era palace on Shamla Hills — Tripadvisor #6 of 161 Bhopal hotels. Heritage Hotels of India member with British-colonial + Italian-Renaissance architecture, four restaurants including the iconic Under-the-Mango-Tree.

existing.name: Noor-us-Sabah Palace Homestay
existing.issue: name-confusion — 'Noor-us-Sabah Palace' is the real WelcomHeritage/ITC-managed 57-room heritage hotel (₹6,500+/night), not a 'family-run homestay' at ₹2,500-4,500. Description fabricated. Replace with Courtyard by Marriott for an honest value mid-range, OR retag Noor-Us-Sabah Palace at the correct price tier.

replacement.name: Courtyard by Marriott Bhopal
replacement.tagline: Marriott's central Bhopal property next to DB City Mall — the airport-friendly 5-star with a polished pool deck, all-day-dining MoMo Café, and the most predictable 4-5 star service in the city. The default business pick.
replacement.address: 1 DB City, Maharana Pratap Nagar, Zone 1, Bhopal 462011, Madhya Pradesh

existing.name: Hotel Amaltas
existing.issue: verify — claims walking distance to Raj Bhawan, Birla Museum and Van Vihar entrance. Hotel Amaltas Inn is real on MP Nagar but is NOT walkable to those sites (~5-8km from Van Vihar). Correct the location claim. The Bhopal 'location' slot is better served by Noor-Us-Sabah Palace which is genuinely on Upper Lake with VIP Road / Koh-e-Fiza access — close to Bhopal's lake circuit + airport.

replacement.name: WelcomHeritage Noor-Us-Sabah Palace
replacement.tagline: 13-acre 20th-century palace on Koh-e-Fiza hill above Upper Lake — ITC-WelcomHeritage managed, 57 rooms, lake-view breakfast lawn. The most scenic Bhopal base for the lake-and-mosque circuit (Taj-ul-Masajid is 4 km).
replacement.address: V.I.P. Road, Koh-e-Fiza, Bhopal 462001, Madhya Pradesh

existing.name: Lakeshore Cottage (Upper Lake)
existing.issue: fabricated — 'Lakeshore Cottage' as a Bhopal cottage operation with shoreline boat launch is not verifiable on Booking, MMT, or Tripadvisor. Listicle ghost. Bhopal's actual lake-adjacent retreat is Jehan Numa Retreat at the edge of Van Vihar National Park (the lake's southern protected fringe).

replacement.name: Jehan Numa Retreat
replacement.tagline: Jehan Numa Group's second Bhopal property at the edge of Van Vihar National Park — cottages around landscaped gardens, more nature than the palace. The choice for couples who want the Jehan Numa pedigree without the city-centre traffic.
replacement.address: Van Vihar National Park Road, near Shahpura Lake, Bhopal 462066
